characterDescription: Bold Structural Bar: 56px height with 4px black bottom border — the nav IS an architectural boundary, not a decorative overlay. Barlow 700 uppercase at 0.75rem with 0.08em tracking reads as Constructivist poster typography. Always visible, no scroll transition, no transparency. Item spacing 40px. The thick bottom border defines the top of the page as a physical edge.

_twist.description: Bold architectural nav: 56px height, 4px bottom border, Barlow 700 uppercase. Rejects fade-away scroll behavior — the nav is an architectural element, always present. No backdrop filter, no box shadow, no transition. Check C: fontFamily 'Barlow' is present in assembled type system (ds-type-nav-font-family).
